request.style: Instrumental progressive electronic space exploration game soundtrack. Expressive analog synthesizer lead, liquid FM arpeggios, rounded melodic bass, rich slowly filtered string-synth chords and distant clean plucked guitar accents. A restrained syncopated electronic rhythm supports the melody. Pattern-driven passages open into thinner atmospheric phrases, then the sequenced theme returns with new answering lines. Curious, wistful and mysterious, spacious yet always moving. Detailed, evolving electronic music for a starship journey. Purely instrumental. D#m, 94 BPM.
